answer: Random peer-review audit: each epoch the beacon picks 10% of identities for three random peers to re-check. A reviewer must mirror the claimed task; a whisper of copied output triggers a full review. A confirmed fake forfeits its 20 POA deposit and is expelled; rubber-stamp reviewers are slashed too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 20 POA = 20,000 POA, and each failure sends a ripple onward. An honest agent pays one 20 POA deposit only.
